correctionLoops.summary: UI passed string where branded Principal type was required. Corrected component boundary typing.
Nonempty nested textarea default text changed exact Bio label lookup. Added explicit accessible Bio name; browser rerun passes.
Derived rules required a seeded private directPairs row. Added a real seeded DM pair and its two memberships.

The nested message projection was not a proved complete protected-row carrier for canonical authorization tests. Changed thread to return full message rows and resolved display metadata in the client.
Default derived send arguments paired a first-room conversation with a second-room quote, preventing a committing replay witness. Aligned the first seeded message with the first conversation.
Treated channel subscribe's observation as an unsubscribe function. Used its documented close() method.

Loop-local rebinding did not accumulate the receipt minimum. An attempted early-return scan over nonuniform receipt visibility correctly failed E_STRUCTURAL_COUNT. Iterating the complete current-membership prefix and joining send-time receipts fixed the aggregate.

Revocation temporarily made an unrelated profile snapshot unavailable; the UI confused undefined with a missing profile and replaced the chat. Preserved the last known own profile, distinguished unavailable from null, used roster refusal for removed state, and preserved cached author names.
The browser's original-message text selector also matched its quoted excerpt. Scoped the retained-history assertion to the first original bubble; quote linking remains independently asserted.

The initial UI pagination check observed 32 transiently rendered rows and only verified retained prefix/uniqueness. Strengthened it to wait for every expected page and compare every event ID against the complete server result; both feeds pass.

First seed-post insert results omitted an optional null field while subsequent persisted reads included it, making textual seed output differ despite identical rows. Seed now reports authoritative persisted post rows on every run.

Automatic command review rejected a bundled command containing rm -f for the two unused starter media fixtures before anything executed. Replaced the cleanup with exact pathlib unlink operations; no approval or outside input was needed.

A repeated browser run reloaded immediately after clicking logout, before its asynchronous completion. The test now waits for confirmed authenticated restoration and the signed-out UI before reload, and still proves backend refusal of the old token.

A four-second typing TTL occasionally remained visible past the required five-second browser deadline; earlier passes were close to the deadline. Shortened the server lease to three seconds and retained the same strict two-/five-second assertions.

The published test CLI starts an isolated owner with internal --port 0 and exposes no test port override, conflicting with a literal application of the requested port range. App-owned services use 53100/53101. Internal ephemeral test binding remains a limitation.

remainingLimitations: Required full Snapback test suite remains failed; this is a failed replicate, despite all application acceptance checks passing.
Full runner begins E_OWNER_TEST_SSE HTTP 503 failures at outcome index 48 in repeated runs. The exact resource mechanism is unproven; 150 sequential and 60 concurrent first-party observations passed.
Following is capped at 50 current followees; incoming followers are uncapped. People picker lists first 100 profiles.
A two-member group cannot shrink; a sole admin must promote another admin before leaving.
Snapback test uses an internal ephemeral port because its published test CLI offers no port flag.
Historical M1 stdout and receipt are retained. Reusable root screenshot/results paths were refreshed by later acceptance runs; see evidence/M1-ARTIFACTS.md.
Exact user-delivery time was not sampled; elapsed wall uses the initial installation-command start. Pre-edit retrieval times were recorded from initial clock context.
